segment.source: Renders the reductions that depend on who is asking: nonprofit, education, startup, open source, public sector. Each entry gets an icon, the size of the reduction and a line on how to prove eligibility. Use it for: a nonprofit rate band under a pricing table, a student discount notice, a programme page for community projects. Prefer 'Launch Offer Price' for a discount everyone gets, and 'Quote Request Panel' when eligibility has to be assessed case by case.
